name: border-draw
purpose: Reveals a section or card emphasis line through a composited scale transform instead of border-width changes.

cwvImpact.rationale: The visual line keeps its allocated space and only its pseudo-element transform changes during one short transition.

accessibility.reducedMotionFallback: The emphasis line is rendered fully present with all motion disabled.

cwvTripwire.layoutShift: The emphasis line retains allocated space while only its transform changes.
cwvTripwire.longAnimation: The draw cue is capped at --dur-2 and has no repeating animation.
